text: The comment form is built with `<form … method="post">` and the template explicitly notes that the submission will be “submitted with the POST method” for CSRF protection [1]. The view that processes the comment is decorated with `require_POST`, which “only allow[s] POST requests for this view” and returns a 405 error for any other method [2]. Because the server expects a POST request to create a new comment, using GET would never reach the view’s logic and would be rejected. Thus the correct HTTP verb for submitting a new comment is POST.
